title: [epic] GOAL: Epic 1 - architecture + first scored baseline
description:
Two strands, deliberately split. The BASELINE strand exists to produce a real leaderboard number
fast, using methods we already trust; the ARCHITECTURE strand builds the model that is meant to beat
it. They meet at the operating-point sweep.

The gate between them: nothing in the architecture strand is worth tuning until the evaluator is
verified and a trivial baseline has a number. Deadline 2026-09-29; top LB 0.929 as of 2026-07-23.

Score = adj_edge_jaccard + 0.1 * division_jaccard, with
adj_edge_jaccard = max(0, J * (1 - 0.1 * (N_pred - N_total)/N_total)).
See docs/PLAN.md and interpretations/tracking/2026-07-23_dataset-survey.md.
